contract.purpose: Replace movement-class analysis for a warehouse using transaction activity and zero-hit inventory.
inputs_defaults: CREATE PROCEDURE MOVECLS_MineMovementClassAnalysisData ( @Warehouse nvarchar(25), @Days int = 90, @Permanent nchar(1), @IncludeArchivedData nchar(1) ) AS
Only explicit declaration defaults permit omission; catalog has_default_value is not used to infer T-SQL defaults.
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: NULL warehouse returns early. NULL days gives NULL date bound; negative days not rejected. NULL permanent flag takes unrestricted branch; NULL archive flag excludes archive.
output_shape: One unnamed SELECT of affected-row total or-1, but @@ERROR is read after SET NOCOUNT OFF rather than the writes. NULL warehouse returns-1 without raising stored error text.

ordered_branches.explanation: Window ends at tomorrow UTC midnight and starts @Days earlier (default90), including the current partial day. Deletes existing analysis for warehouse first. Aggregates fixed direction and transaction types40,60,100,130,120,240,250,360 from current history plus optional archive when flag=Y, grouped item/company/location/UM/class. UNION, not UNION ALL, can collapse equal current/archive aggregate rows. Item join accepts matching company OR either sideNULL, allowing fanout. Permanent=Y additionally joins current inventory by location/warehouse/lot/company without item/logistics-unit/attribute match and requires PERMANENT<>N, allowing multiplication across inventory rows. Otherwise no permanent restriction. Adds positive-onhand inventory with zero hits where no existing analysis item/company/location match; totals then represent onhand for zero-hit rows versus movement quantity for hit rows. Dates/days/status configuration and input flags are not validated.

program.text: INSERT INTO MOVEMENT_CLASS_ANALYSIS (ITEM, COMPANY, WAREHOUSE, LOCATION, TOTAL_QUANTITY, QUANTITY_UM, ITEM_CLASS, NUMBER_OF_HITS, NUMBER_OF_DAYS, DATE_TIME_STAMP, USER_STAMP,			PROCESS_STAMP)
SELECT ITEM, COMPANY, WAREHOUSE, LOCATION,  sum(TOTAL_QUATITY) AS TOTAL_QUATITY, QUANTITY_UM, ITEM_CLASS,SUM(NUMBER_OF_HITS), @Days , GETUTCDATE(),N'<literal:3>',N'<literal:4>'
SELECT TH.ITEM, TH.COMPANY, TH.WAREHOUSE, TH.LOCATION,  sum(TH.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QUATITY, th.QUANTITY_UM, I.ITEM_CLASS,NUMBER_OF_HITS
SELECT TRANSACTION_HISTORY.ITEM, TRANSACTION_HISTORY.COMPANY, TRANSACTION_HISTORY.WAREHOUSE, TRANSACTION_HISTORY.LOCATION, TRANSACTION_HISTORY.QUANTITY_UM,
sum(TRANSACTION_HISTORY.QUANTITY) as QUANTITY, COUNT(*) as NUMBER_OF_HITS
INNER JOIN LOCATION_INVENTORY LI on TRANSACTION_HISTORY.LOCATION  = LI.LOCATION AND TRANSACTION_HISTORY.WAREHOUSE = LI.WAREHOUSE
ON I.ITEM = TH.ITEM   AND (TH.COMPANY = I.COMPANY OR (TH.COMPANY IS NULL OR I.COMPANY IS NULL))
SELECT TH.ITEM, TH.COMPANY, TH.WAREHOUSE, TH.LOCATION,  sum(TH.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QUATITY, th.QUANTITY_UM, I.ITEM_CLASS,NUMBER_OF_HITS
SELECT AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.ITEM, AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.COMPANY, AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.WAREHOUSE, AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.LOCATION, AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.QUANTITY_UM,
sum(AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.QUANTITY) as QUANTITY, COUNT(*) as NUMBER_OF_HITS
INNER JOIN LOCATION_INVENTORY LI on AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.LOCATION  = LI.LOCATION AND AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.WAREHOUSE = LI.WAREHOUSE
ON I.ITEM = TH.ITEM   AND (TH.COMPANY = I.COMPANY OR (TH.COMPANY IS NULL OR I.COMPANY IS NULL))
INSERT INTO MOVEMENT_CLASS_ANALYSIS (ITEM, COMPANY, WAREHOUSE, LOCATION, TOTAL_QUANTITY, QUANTITY_UM, ITEM_CLASS, NUMBER_OF_HITS, NUMBER_OF_DAYS, DATE_TIME_STAMP, USER_STAMP,PROCESS_STAMP)
SELECT 	ITEM, COMPANY, WAREHOUSE, LOCATION,  sum(TOTAL_QUATITY) AS TOTAL_QUATITY, QUANTITY_UM, ITEM_CLASS,SUM(NUMBER_OF_HITS), @DAYS , GETUTCDATE(),N'<literal:20>',N'<literal:21>'
SELECT TH.ITEM, TH.COMPANY, TH.WAREHOUSE, TH.LOCATION,  sum(TH.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QUATITY, th.QUANTITY_UM, I.ITEM_CLASS, NUMBER_OF_HITS
SELECT TRANSACTION_HISTORY.ITEM, TRANSACTION_HISTORY.COMPANY, TRANSACTION_HISTORY.WAREHOUSE, TRANSACTION_HISTORY.LOCATION, QUANTITY_UM,
sum(TRANSACTION_HISTORY.QUANTITY) as QUANTITY, COUNT(*) as NUMBER_OF_HITS
GROUP BY TRANSACTION_HISTORY.ITEM, TRANSACTION_HISTORY.COMPANY, TRANSACTION_HISTORY.WAREHOUSE, TRANSACTION_HISTORY.LOCATION,QUANTITY_UM
ON I.ITEM = TH.ITEM   AND (TH.COMPANY = I.COMPANY OR (TH.COMPANY IS NULL OR I.COMPANY IS NULL))
SELECT TH.ITEM, TH.COMPANY, TH.WAREHOUSE, TH.LOCATION,  sum(TH.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QUATITY, th.QUANTITY_UM, I.ITEM_CLASS,NUMBER_OF_HITS
SELECT AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.ITEM, AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.COMPANY, AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.WAREHOUSE, AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.LOCATION, QUANTITY_UM,
sum(AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY.QUANTITY) as QUANTITY, COUNT(*) as NUMBER_OF_HITS
ON I.ITEM = TH.ITEM   AND (TH.COMPANY = I.COMPANY OR (TH.COMPANY IS NULL OR I.COMPANY IS NULL))
INSERT INTO MOVEMENT_CLASS_ANALYSIS (ITEM, COMPANY, WAREHOUSE, LOCATION, TOTAL_QUANTITY, QUANTITY_UM, ITEM_CLASS, NUMBER_OF_HITS, NUMBER_OF_DAYS, DATE_TIME_STAMP, USER_STAMP,PROCESS_STAMP)
SELECT 	li.ITEM, li.COMPANY, li.WAREHOUSE, li.LOCATION,  sum(ON_HAND_QTY) AS TOTAL_QUATITY, QUANTITY_UM, ITEM_CLASS, 0 , @Days , GETUTCDATE(),N'<literal:28>',N'<literal:29>'
inner join location loc on (loc.location =li.LOCATION and loc.warehouse =li.warehouse)
left join item on (item.item = li.item and (item.COMPANY = li.COMPANY OR (item.COMPANY IS NULL and li.COMPANY IS NULL)))

and not exists (select N'<literal:32>' from MOVEMENT_CLASS_ANALYSIS mca where mca.warehouse = li.warehouse and mca.LOCATION = li.LOCATION AND mca.ITEM = li.ITEM and (mca.COMPANY = li.COMPANY OR (mca.COMPANY IS NULL AND li.COMPANY IS NULL)) )
li.ITEM, li.COMPANY, li.WAREHOUSE, li.LOCATION, QUANTITY_UM, ITEM_CLASS
INSERT INTO MOVEMENT_CLASS_ANALYSIS (ITEM, COMPANY, WAREHOUSE, LOCATION, TOTAL_QUANTITY, QUANTITY_UM, ITEM_CLASS, NUMBER_OF_HITS, NUMBER_OF_DAYS, DATE_TIME_STAMP, USER_STAMP,PROCESS_STAMP)
SELECT 	li.ITEM, li.COMPANY, li.WAREHOUSE, li.LOCATION,  sum(ON_HAND_QTY) AS TOTAL_QUATITY, QUANTITY_UM, ITEM_CLASS, 0 , @Days , GETUTCDATE(),N'<literal:33>',N'<literal:34>'
inner join location loc on (loc.location =li.LOCATION and loc.warehouse =li.warehouse)
left join item on (item.item = li.item and (item.COMPANY = li.COMPANY OR (item.COMPANY IS NULL and li.COMPANY IS NULL)))

and not exists (select N'<literal:36>' from MOVEMENT_CLASS_ANALYSIS mca where mca.warehouse = li.warehouse and mca.LOCATION = li.LOCATION AND mca.ITEM = li.ITEM and (mca.COMPANY = li.COMPANY OR (mca.COMPANY IS NULL AND li.COMPANY IS NULL)) )
li.ITEM, li.COMPANY, li.WAREHOUSE, li.LOCATION, QUANTITY_UM, ITEM_CLASS
